fields.title: Select domain value columns
fields.description: Select the columns from the second input table that should be used to add domain values to the columns in the first input table with matching names and types.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: If domain value columns are not present in data
fields.description: Determines if the execution should either fail or the column should be ignored if an included column does not exist in the input table (1st).

fields.title: If column types do not match
fields.description: Determines if the execution should either fail or the column should be ignored if the types of an included column are not equal.

fields.title: Domain values (2nd input) will be inserted
fields.description: The ordering of the values in the domain might be relevant for downstream nodes, e.g. predictor nodes, which append new columns representing the different possible values. This option determines the ordering in the output, whereby the additional domain values (2nd input) can be either inserted before or after existing domain values (1st input).

fields.title: Maximum amount of possible domain values
fields.description: Sets the upper bound of the number of possible domain values. An extreme high amount of possible domain values may influence and even crash the rest of the workflow, since table specifications are held in memory. It is highly recommended to use the given default.
